symptom: PowerShell runtime does not provide System.Convert.ToHexString
impact: First aggregate probe returned empty hashes; no file was written and no project state changed.
correction: Recomputed with BitConverter.ToString and independently matched the frozen package aggregate.

symptom: Windows path length caused one HTML snapshot copy to fail.
impact: The mirror transaction reported failure and rolled back; formal root unchanged.
correction: Replayed from a temporary short drive mapping to the same independent package and passed.

symptom: A mapped drive created in one shell process was not visible in a later shell process.
impact: The command failed before running a transaction; no state changed.
correction: Created, used, and removed the temporary mapping inside one PowerShell process.

symptom: UTF-8 without BOM made Windows PowerShell 5.1 decode Chinese path literals incorrectly.
impact: The helper failed before producing static-review.json; no formal state changed.
correction: Saved the helper as UTF-8 BOM and reran it successfully.

symptom: Array.Reverse mutated the source arrays, so the first persisted summary recorded false reverse-order booleans despite earlier assertions passing.
impact: Only the disposable local summary was wrong; original journals and transaction results were unchanged.
correction: Generated independent reversed copies, reran assertions against original journals, and replaced scenario-audit.json with true results.

symptom: Where-Object comparison syntax was malformed, producing an empty aggregate in the first aggregate file.
impact: The review manifest itself was correct; only its aggregate summary was wrong.
correction: Recomputed with scriptblock comparison, confirmed 30 included rows, and replaced the aggregate summary.
